newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soyoil ends higher, soymeal lower.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soyoil ends higher, soymeal lower.

text.p: CBOT soyoil futures closed higher and soymeal closed lower with a reversal and profit taking of meal/oil spreads cited, traders said.
Little new feature was evident and the market was drifting after a sharp break in prices Tuesday, they said.

Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 17,000 contracts, below the 22,701 traded Tuesday, according to the CBOT. Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 24,000 contracts, below the 29,057 traded Tuesday.
Soyoil closed 0.07 cent per lb higher to 0.04 lower, with December up 0.07 at 22.63 cents. Soymeal closed $1.50 to $2.80 per ton lower, with December down $1.60 at $235.10 a ton.
